coordination.rule: Each API owner publishes its final contract before dependent edits. Each file has one editor.

scoring.method: Each category weight is divided equally among its listed criteria. A passed criterion earns its share in each linked category.
scoring.rounding: Keep exact fractions for calculation and round the final percentage to two decimal places.
scoring.passing_rule: Every outcome and required evidence item passes on the integrated source and dependency identities.
scoring.pending_rule: Pending evidence is unassessed. Both scores remain null until baseline assessment completes. Failed and reopened criteria earn no credit.
scoring.freeze_rule: Category weights and criterion membership remain fixed. A new finding reopens an affected criterion.
scoring.report_rule: Each update lists closed, remaining and reopened criteria with the resulting score delta.
scoring.completion_rule: All criteria pass and no high or medium code finding remains. Deferred release work does not contribute to either score.
scoring.baseline_assessment_rule: Assess every criterion against integrated evidence before publishing either baseline percentage. Record failures explicitly rather than treating pending as zero.

compact_encoding.outputs: Every output is a real ring output with the same asset as the sole real input.
compact_encoding.standard_data_body: Base body followed by encrypted u16 big endian extension length and extension bytes, then zero padding to the common frame width.
compact_encoding.extension_bytes: Optional ring hash flag, optional ring hash and application data.
compact_encoding.decoder_rule: Explicit format selection without fallback. Missing keys fail closed.
compact_encoding.sender_change: Sender change consumes one output slot and reduces delivered recipient capacity.
compact_encoding.format_agreement: The frame flag, audit layout, proof key format and SPP body scheme must select the same format.
compact_encoding.recovery_format: Recovery selects the decoder from the SPP body scheme before decryption.

projection_admission.memory_full: TrackingRefusal::Incomplete before changing either cache or queue.

hosted_legs.ordering: Existing source and payment lines precede ordered exit and withdrawal lines.

hosted_legs.mint_resolution: Authenticate token program against the actual mint account.
hosted_legs.withdrawal_recipient: SOL uses the recipient account. SPL uses the recipient owner and derives its token account from owner, mint and token program.

managed_merge_selection.first_pass: Collect scalar asset totals, entry counts and eligible counts per tree.
managed_merge_selection.second_pass: Retain the smallest nonzero keyed entries on the selected tree, up to the selected width for each asset.
managed_merge_selection.entry_retention: No candidate entries remain for an unselected tree.
managed_merge_selection.asset_reads: No repeated owner scan for each selected asset.
managed_merge_selection.read_scope: One database read snapshot or one memory read guard covers both passes and batched spend checks.
managed_merge_selection.tree_choice: Select the fullest tree, with the lowest tree identifier on ties.
managed_merge_selection.width: Apply MergeTarget to all eligible source counts and amounts, capped by MERGE_DEFAULT_INPUT_COUNT.
managed_merge_selection.memory_bound: O(distinct asset and tree counters + selected assets * MERGE_DEFAULT_INPUT_COUNT + OWNER_ROW_BATCH)
